svg.text: Ambainis [2012] Variable-Time Amplitude Amplification (VTAA) Cost Analysis:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Stage 1 (16-bit Prefix Monoid mu_1): Cost t_1 = 15 CCX. Rejects 89.3% of non-matching pairs!

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: Survival probability p_1 = Pr[Binomial(256, 0.5) ≥ 11 in 16 bits] = 0.107.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Stage 2 (256-bit Full Braun Tree mu_root): Cost t_2 = 255 CCX (0 uncompute CCX via MBU).

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: Executed after k_1 = 4 fast Stage-1 reflections; survival probability p_2 = 0.016.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Stage 3 (Exact int8x256 Inner Product): Cost t_3 = 3,072 CCX. Executed ONLY on Stage-2

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: survivors → Expected root-mean-square VTAA cost = 800 Toffolis/query (3.84x Reduction!).

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Monoidal Finger Tree caches partial Hamming weights mu_1 = sum_{i=0}^{15} [u_i == v_i] at the
